key_findings: Render loop audit, coverage, metrics, scale, and timing artifacts into views.
Renderer, schema, report, visualization, and CI tests are required.
P14 and real/fault wrappers are forbidden for L05.
Reads committed JSON source artifacts and writes HTML/CSV/SVG views.
Rejects MEASURED/PASS metric values sourced from rendered views.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_renderer
proposed_harness.acceptance: Renderer writes required L05 report views and report_index.json from source artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Report and visualization tests validate source-driven CSV/SVG/HTML output and missing semantics.

proposed_harness.name: loop_report_ci_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: CI runs static renderer/schema/tests without P14 or real/fault wrappers.

implementation_plan.rationale: L05 required reports are views over committed machine-readable artifacts.

implementation_plan.step: Validate report index and view semantics
implementation_plan.rationale: Prevent rendered views becoming sources and preserve missing/skipped semantics.
Keep L05 report generation in default static gates.

acceptance_criteria: Generated L05 report bundle exists and validates.
Missing/skipped/no-baseline semantics remain visible with reasons.
P14 is shown only as dry-run/skipped non-real coverage.
No P14 or real/fault wrappers are run.
risks: Rendered views could be mistaken for sources without source_of_truth=false.
Hardcoded values could hide source artifact drift.
Missing metrics could be filtered out or values invented.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not edit historical phase/gate artifacts.
Do not hardcode report numbers outside source artifact reads.
Do not run P14 or real/fault wrappers.
notes: Review initially requested measured-source guard coverage for MEASURED and top-level report_index source_of_truth=false. Main agent fixed both. Recheck approved with no findings.
